scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of asymptotic constants and Gaussian radial law; finite checks are diagnostic, not an infinite proof or independent validation. No claim of global novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Only positive power-law coordinate flip weights with exponent greater than one, and an initially localized empty vertex.
Hamming graph distance only; no pathwise or multi-time functional central limit theorem, and no claim for non-summable weights.
Berry--Esseen rate not claimed optimal; comparisons to prior published work are best-knowledge.
title: Power-law radial transport and Gaussian fluctuations of a locally infinite quantum walk
